label: Skinny, pale, spotty, big ears
prompt: A photorealistic, slightly washed-out frame from the front camera of a phone propped against a stack of paperbacks on a shelf in a rented attic room, the picture soft and a little grainy as a cheap lens gives it, the image filling the whole frame edge to edge with nothing laid over it. Brandon, 22, a skinny underfed young man with a narrow, very pale face, a scatter of angry red spots across his forehead and chin, thin cracked lips, sunken cheeks and ears that stick out like open car doors, mousy hair flattened on one side from the pillow. He sits cross-legged on a bare single mattress in a faded oversized grey hoodie with frayed cuffs, wrists like sticks, looking at the lens with a hopeful, blank stare, mouth slightly open as if mid-sentence. The only light is the glow of the phone screen on his face from below, mixing with a dim orange bulb out of frame, so his skin looks greenish-white and the sloping attic ceiling behind him falls into murky shadow. Visible pores, shiny oily patches at the nose, dry flaking skin by one eyebrow, mismatched cheap bedding and a damp patch on the plaster behind him. Thanks.

label: Soft, pudgy, round face, thinning hair
prompt: A photorealistic, murky still as seen by the lens of a phone leaning on a windowsill in a cramped English attic bedroom, the picture slightly overexposed where daylight leaks in and muddy everywhere else, shown as a plain full-bleed photograph with nothing drawn on top of it. Brandon, 22, a soft, pudgy young man with a round moon face, a double chin starting, patchy ginger-brown stubble that grows in clumps and leaves bare gaps along the jaw, and a hairline already retreating at the temples with thin hair combed forward over the forehead. He sits slumped at a wobbly desk in a stretched navy tracksuit top, crumbs on the chest, leaning close to the lens so his face fills much of the frame, eyebrows raised in earnest worry, a little sweat on the upper lip. Pale flat daylight from a grubby skylight above and behind him blows out the edge of the picture, and a cold blue cast from the screen he is reading lights the front of his face. Pink flushed cheeks, creased eyelids, slightly chapped skin, a mug ringed with tea stains and a heap of clothes on a chair behind him. Thanks.

label: Gangly, long face, overbite, orange fringe
prompt: A photorealistic still from the front camera of a phone wedged into the gap of a wardrobe door in a rented attic, the lens close and slightly wide so the face stretches a touch at the edges, picture noisy and dim like a phone in a poorly lit room, the whole frame clean photograph with nothing overlaid. Brandon, 22, a gangly young man with a long horse-like face, a pronounced overbite that keeps his front teeth resting on his lower lip, a prominent Adam's apple, and a home-bleached fringe that has turned a brassy, patchy orange with darker brown roots showing at the parting. He is crouched forward on the edge of a sagging bed in a thin black t-shirt with a cracked print, long collarbones, knobbly shoulders, eyes wide and a little too intense, mid-grin, head tilted toward the lens. Light comes from one bare bulb on a flex hanging off-centre above him, throwing hard shadows under his brow and nose, plus a faint blue flicker from the screen. Chemical-damaged straw-like hair, a pink scalp patch where the bleach burned, a few stubble hairs on a narrow chin, fading yellow bruise on one forearm, peeling wallpaper behind. Thanks.

label: Short, stocky, mixed-race, scarred, clipper cut
prompt: A photorealistic still in the manner of a phone's front camera, the phone balanced on a pile of cardboard boxes at the end of a rented attic room, picture a bit compressed and warm-greyed, with one side of the frame lit brighter than the other, delivered as a clean full-frame photograph with nothing placed over it. Brandon, 22, a short, stocky, broad-chested mixed-race British young man with warm light-brown skin, a thick neck, deep acne scars pitting both cheeks and the jaw, and a terrible home clipper job: uneven patches of fuzz, a stripe shaved too close above the left ear, a ragged step at the crown. His dark eyes are bright and very eager, eyebrows lifted, a big hopeful half-smile showing slightly crooked teeth, face pushed a little too close to the lens. He wears a tight, bobbled burgundy jumper with one sleeve pushed up over a thick forearm. Weak grey daylight comes from a small roof window to his right, with a yellow lamp low on the left, so one cheek is cool and the other warm and the scarring catches the light. Faint sheen on the forehead, ingrown stubble on the chin, a tiny scab near his hairline, a drying rack of grey socks behind his shoulder. Thanks.
